# Format Factory — Legacy/Manual Backfill Policy

## Identifying Legacy/Manual Work
A mutation is legacy/manual if any of these are true:
1. No execution_method in evidence declaration
2. No source marker or sidecar attribution
3. No skill_id or skill_transcript in sprint evidence
4. Evidence declaration predates the execution-method taxonomy

Current status: WORKS_BUT_NOT_REPEATABLE
Backfill target: BACKFILLED_LEGACY_EXECUTION

## Sidecar-First Rule
DEFAULT: Create sidecar attribution YAML only. No source file modifications.
OPTIONAL: Add FORMAT_FACTORY_EXECUTION comment to source ONLY IF:
  (a) formatter/linter does not reject the comment (verify with pre-edit test run)
  (b) No test failures introduced by the comment-only edit
  (c) Coordinator approves based on verification results
If source comment not added: sidecar alone satisfies backfill policy.

## Compliant Rollback for Backfill Work (AGENTS.md AE2)
- Sidecar files: delete the created .attribution.yaml file
- Source comments (if added): remove the single comment line; record in adaptation-log.md
- PROHIBITED: git checkout --, git reset, git restore, git clean

## What Backfilled Work May Claim
May claim: WORKS, LEGACY_BACKFILLED
May NOT claim: REPEATABLE, AUTONOMOUS, GOVERNED, QUEUE_DISPATCHED

## Preventing Legacy Work from Supporting Autonomy Claims
Any sprint claiming "autonomous execution" must list action_ids for queue-dispatched items.
BACKFILLED_LEGACY_EXECUTION items do NOT count toward:
- autonomous cycle counts
- autonomous work item counts
- Level 3+ maturity claims

## Correcting False Claims in Project Memory
.supervisor/project-memory.md and external MEMORY.md entries that claim
"6 machine-dispatched cycles" for the autonomous-execution-spine sprint
must be corrected to read: "6 validation/state queue items dispatched;
4 product functions written manually (BACKFILLED_LEGACY_EXECUTION)"
